class.name: OcgStdselectFacefilter
class.brief_description: A framework to define a filter to select a specific type of face. The types available include: - any face - a planar face - a cylindrical face - a spherical face - a toroidal face - a revol face.
class.description: ! A framework to define a filter to select a specific type of face. ! The types available include: ! - any face ! - a planar face ! - a cylindrical face ! - a spherical face ! - a toroidal face ! - a revol face.

method.name: StdSelect_FaceFilter
method.description: Constructs a face filter object defined by the type of face aTypeOfFace.

method.name: SetType
method.description: Sets the type of face aNewType. aNewType is to be highlighted in selection.

method.name: Type
method.description: Returns the type of face to be highlighted in selection.
